purpose: Track family-level visual learner construction separately from family research/backfill status.

rules.module_built: A canonical content/taxa/<Family>/family.json contains a visual_lesson and all referenced anchor species exist in the manifest.
rules.visual_ready: At least one canonical species anchor has a locked image; photo-specific steps may still be marked polish_pending.
rules.photo_blocked: Family research is sufficient but current canonical website species lack locked images or no species are promoted.
